prd.t008: Parasitic Armor 'Predator' is what unlocks Dark Bridge's low HP mode, which switches the special to 1-1-4 hits with a different motion.
prd.t010: Assign the corners before you start
prd.t011: Most wipes come from two players running to the same corner. Decide who takes which corner in the lobby, not during the fight.
prd.t012: Give every player one corner of the raft up front. The community names them after the warps and the NPC: red, blue, green and ill gill.
prd.t013: If you cannot reach your own corner in time, swap with the player on the same side. Front left (ill gill) pairs with back left (blue), and front right (green) pairs with back right (red).
prd.t014: Three teleporters coloured red, blue and green plus the NPC ill gill show up as map markers, so you can orient yourself from the map.
prd.t015: The raft layout used by the pattern charts. Explosion sizes are marked on the chart itself.
prd.t016: An optional area skin that paints the safe ground. Drop the file into the scene folder to use it.
prd.t018: Five steps, in order. Each chart shows where the damage lands and where you should be standing.
prd.t019: Toxic ends with four players spread at their assigned corners. Tap a chart to enlarge it.
prd.t021: Same idea, different pattern. Watch for the finish.
prd.t022: After pt.5 the attack ends with a stack-damage explosion, so group up instead of spreading out.
prd.t024: A boss announces its skill name before it fires. The symbols in the name tell you what shape the attack takes, so learning them is faster than memorising every skill.
prd.t028: Damage falls off with distance from the centre of the explosion.
prd.t030: Circular area of effect. Spread out from each other.
prd.t035: Increases the damage you take from the [X] attribute.
prd.t037: Your HP must be full when the effect ends.
prd.t038: Source: the raid channel, plus the How to Soul Butcher thread in the Discord strategy forum. Pattern charts and the corner strategy by Rang3r, area skin by thanx JP.
prd.t040: A difficulty 10 raid built around one boss, Soul Butcher. The fight is a positioning puzzle on a raft, and the pattern charts below are what make it learnable.
prd.t042: The diagrams show where safe zones are. These clips show when to move: watch the call, let the hit finish, then reset to your assigned position.
prd.t046: A player cannot reach their assigned corner.
prd.t048: Call the swap immediately and take your partner's corner on the same side. Never cross through the middle.
prd.t050: Two players silently choose the same corner and overlap explosions.
prd.t052: Soul Explosion X resolves on the grouped party, followed by [<<-->>] Twin Blast.
prd.t053: Hold until Soul Explosion X finishes, then spread to assigned positions for Twin Blast.
prd.t054: Leaving before the first blast finishes or remaining stacked for Twin Blast overlaps the follow-up.
prd.t056: [<<-->>] Fire Blast appears: the spread symbol means each player receives a circular area.
prd.t057: Take an assigned edge or corner with enough spacing and hold it until the blast fully resolves.
prd.t058: Returning to the middle early overlaps personal areas or catches the remaining hits.
prd.t060: Ancient Grants designates one player while the group is close.
prd.t061: The marked player isolates to the called side; everyone else creates space from that player.
prd.t062: Following the marked player turns a single-target burst into party damage.
prd.t064: For this cast, the caller announces front → right → middle → corners.
prd.t065: Move as one group for shared safe zones, but fan out to assigned corners at the corner call.
prd.t066: Cutting across the raft or anticipating the next step breaks the formation.
prd.t068: Ancient Rabarta appears while the party is holding near the edge.
prd.t069: Stop and wait for the ice/line effect to finish, then follow the next call into the middle.
prd.t070: Moving as soon as you reach the edge puts you back into the unresolved attack.
prd.t071: Practical rules that prevent most wipes
prd.t073: Use short calls: centre, corner, side, front, back, colour, stack, spread. Everyone moves on the same call.
prd.t075: After an explosion, add wave or laser, return to your assigned home position unless the next call says otherwise.
prd.t076: Do not revive into an active pattern
prd.t077: Wait for a multi-hit or line attack to finish before using Moon Atomizer or accepting the revive.
prd.t079: Use the red, blue, green and ill gill markers to identify the correct edge without turning the camera.
prd.t084: Group briefly for damage or the shared safe zone; be ready to split on the next call.
prd.t086: Take your assigned corner. If blocked, swap only with the partner on the same side.
prd.t088: Move to the called edge, wait for the full hit, then reset.
prd.t090: Follow the caller to the named map marker; do not invent a second route.
prd.t092: Marked player isolates; the other three spread away.
prd.t094: Hold at the edge until the ice/line effect finishes, then move on the next call.
prd.t096: Group tightly so the damage is shared.
prd.t098: Create space so personal areas do not overlap.
prd.t100: The video is one successful run, so use the on-screen skill name and your party caller as the final timing cue.
prd.t101: Party swaps same-side corners while Soul Butcher attacks.
prd.t102: Soul Explosion X resolves before the party spreads for Twin Blast.
prd.t103: Players spread to assigned edges for Fire Blast.
prd.t104: The selected party member isolates during Ancient Grants.
prd.t105: Party begins the chained route at the front edge.
prd.t106: Party waits at the edge for Ancient Rabarta to finish.
prd.t108: This section follows the whole run from preparation to the kill and fills in mechanics that are easy to miss when only the successful screenshots are shown.
prd.t109: Direction and colour sequences below are what happened in this run. They can change: memorise what each call means, not the example order.
prd.t111: Restock Moon Atomizers and healing items before the real pull. The group makes extra Moon runs after noticing they did not restock.
prd.t112: Restore MAG Sync and finish equipment changes before entering; do not use the first mechanics as setup time.
prd.t114: Observe the first cast, then execute centre → spread → corners → middle → Soul Explosion → home.
prd.t115: A same-side corner swap is safe; crossing the middle or leaving before the explosion ends is not.
prd.t117: An early move into a later phase starts a chain of deaths and repeated spawn kills in this run.
prd.t118: Stop reviving into active hits, finish the mechanic, then rebuild corner assignments before resuming damage.
prd.t120: On the jump call, stay spread for the landing blast. Enter the middle only after the next middle call, then return to corners after it fires.
prd.t121: For colour calls, route through the named markers in the spoken order; keep together and do not leave one player behind.
prd.t122: Personal targets can overlap and one-shot the same player; preserve spacing until the targeting is finished.
prd.t124: Middle is a short damage window, not a permanent position. Reset to corners as soon as the follow-up resolves.
prd.t125: For middle → front → back, destroy the spawned targets first, then return to corners immediately.
prd.t126: The later blue → red → green relay uses the same colour rule; the exact colour order is cast-specific.
prd.t128: The centre is lethal during the side attack. Use the back wall, step out of lightning, and re-enter after the line ends.
prd.t129: If your corner is unreachable, any empty corner is better than overlapping; announce the emergency swap.
prd.t130: Example chain: side → corner → middle → side → green → back. Execute only the current call; do not pre-run the next one.
prd.t131: At the end call, move together and follow the announced colour.
prd.t133: The Grants target isolates; the other three move away from that player.
prd.t134: Observed route: front → right → middle after 2 hits → corners after 4 → wait for the full sweep → slight side → middle → stack.
prd.t135: Count the hits before moving. The clean run of this sequence finishes with no deaths.
prd.t136: The following green → red → blue is another colour relay, not a universal fixed order.
prd.t138: Corners are repeated while the active targets are killed. Do not chase damage across the raft.
prd.t139: On ‘one, two, middle,’ wait through both counts, enter the middle, then use the announced damage window.
prd.t141: Follow as a group → wait one → go → return → wait → blue → green.
prd.t142: Do not forget the laser after the colour route: wait for the beams, then middle, then follow the caller.
prd.t144: Soul Butcher dies at 18:15; the remaining footage is the clear reaction, with no additional mechanic.
prd.t146: Bring a full Moon Atomizer supply and finish MAG/equipment setup before entering. The run loses time and resources correcting this after the pull.
prd.t148: Stay spread for the landing blast. Enter the middle only on the next call.
prd.t150: Wait for the called hit count to finish, then move.
prd.t152: Destroy them during the front/back sequence, then reset to corners.
prd.t160: Centre → split into front/back pairs → assigned corners → remain spread through the finish.
prd.t162: Read the [Toxic] suffix before moving. The last personal areas must not overlap.
prd.t164: Start in the centre, then split two players to the front and two to the back while the four corners explode.
prd.t166: Avoid the left/right blasts and fan out from each pair to the four assigned corners.
prd.t168: The front and back centres explode. Do not leave your corner.
prd.t170: The centre explodes next. Stay at the assigned corner until it resolves.
prd.t172: Each corner receives a large personal area. Finish the pattern spread out; never converge.
prd.t173: Assigned corners → hold → split into front/back pairs → exact centre → remain stacked.
prd.t174: Read the [Blazing] suffix before moving. After pt.5, stay together for the stack-damage explosion.
prd.t176: Start at the four assigned corners so the large personal areas do not overlap.
prd.t178: The centre explodes. Stay out and keep your corner.
prd.t180: The front and back centres explode next. Remain in the corners.
prd.t182: The left and right sides explode. Two players meet at the front centre and two at the back centre.
prd.t183: pt.5 · Stack in the exact centre
prd.t184: The four corners explode. All four players converge in the centre and stay together.
prd.t185: How to read the charts: dark red circles are damage zones, coloured stars are player positions, and arrows show the next move.
prd.t187: Centre → front/back pairs → corners. Finish spread at the four assigned corners.
prd.t188: Corners → front/back pairs → exact centre. Remain stacked after pt.5.
prd.t189: Hold for Soul Explosion X, then spread to assigned positions for Twin Blast.
prd.t190: Spread to assigned edges so the personal areas do not overlap.
